semantics.canonical_imports: Every public symbol is imported from crc_framework; implementation modules expose no alternate public aliases.
semantics.empirical_law: Empirical observations always form the ECDF; interpolated sample quantiles form a QuantileCurve explicitly.
semantics.partial_curve: A QuantileCurve has no whole-law statistics or sampling; queries outside its actual interval fail.
semantics.statistics: Statistics use the complete law, preserve atoms and rare masses, and explicitly represent divergent or undefined outcomes.
semantics.impacts: Event evaluation, expectation, and exact pushforward are separate operations. Expectation uses exact calculation where available and adaptive quadrature otherwise; callers can require an exact calculation. Approximate transforms and context resolution are never implicit.
semantics.mle: An MLE result requires successful likelihood optimization; alternative estimators run only when explicitly configured and appear in the fit record.
semantics.fitting_scope: Only the requested family or explicit candidate specifications execute.
semantics.measurement: Custom quantity and unit identifiers are data; specialized measurement requirements apply only to operations that need them.
semantics.immutability: Public scientific objects and returned array snapshots are immutable.
semantics.protocols: Unresolved context references and resolved point functions have distinct call contracts.
semantics.enum_inputs: Closed Python choices require the declared enum; schema loaders hydrate canonical serialized values without aliases.
semantics.risk_aggregation: Independent binary outcomes contribute additive impacts in their supplied units; there is no implicit weighting or averaging. Tied VaR states use probability-weighted attribution.
semantics.annual_loss: Annual losses and optional components are aligned by year in a common currency. Empirical upper-tail mass is shared uniformly across years tied at the cutoff.
semantics.hurdle: The base is conditioned strictly above atom_location before mixing the declared atom. For atom_probability < 1 a positive base survival mass is required; the truncation is explicit in the representation.
semantics.selection_criterion: Kolmogorov-Smirnov selection applies only to observed samples. Quantile model selection explicitly requests normalized RMSE; probability-labelled evidence is not treated as an empirical sample.
semantics.model_requirements: Typed named measurement and context records share authoritative schemas. Model-owned unestablished calibration facts prevent binding, never trigger invented defaults. Numerical resolution remains separate from scientific data binding.
